name: Eyeball Tank

source.title: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

disable: DC 38 Thievery check (master) or DC 34 Crafting check (expert) to acidify the slime inside the tank, destroying the eyeballs
reset: The trap can be reset by adding 100 new eyeballs to the tank and allowing them to grow in the slime for 1 week.
routine: (3 actions) Each round, the vat uses all three of its actions to shoot random eye rays at any living creatures (except Ixusoth) in range.

items.name: Eye-Opener
items.text:
Trigger Three or more living creatures remain within 20 feet of the trap for 1 round

---

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

items.name: Spill Eyeballs
items.text:
Trigger The tank reaches its Broken Threshold

---
Effect The glass shatters, spilling eyeballs onto the floor in a 15-foot radius and casting Grease (DC 33 Reflex save) on the affected area. The eyeball tank is permanently destroyed and can't be reset.

text: A vat of thick glass stands 10 feet high and is filled with green slime and fist-sized eyeballs.
